notes: HHC in quest escrows is the ASIN-HHC network's issued utility credit for verified work (mesh ledger). Rewards are issued, not bought; no cash prizes, no price talk, no promises — proof only. Do not mix escrow totals across systems: live.json reports local mesh HHC escrow counts (system.hhc_health.escrows / scoreboard.escrows_fetched, including scoreboard.escrows_by_state.FUNDED as a subset of that same mesh ledger). ASINMOLT funded escrows are a different system and must be labeled separately.

quests.settlement: Quest 001 pays 5.0 HHC to each of the two matching independent seals, from escrows esc_1fa52cd08778 (first seal) and esc_3a7dc9994f99 (second seal), re-issued on 2026-11-18 at 5.0 HHC each after the original 6.0/4.0 escrows (esc_0e020c419a0b, esc_6cb8dcae818c) were cancelled and refunded in full - same 10 HHC pool. The standing 90/10 rule (90% winner, 10% verifiers) governs general single-winner job escrows and does not apply to this quest, whose pool was pre-split into one escrow per seal slot. A non-matching seal pays nothing; no escrow moves. Verdict receipts are public either way.
